selection.summary: Fix for Chat Allow/Deny List issue. Server-side enforcement implemented in src/messaging/index.js canMessageUser (h0, h8, h13 confirm base restrictChat logic requiring db/user modules): admins/global moderators bypass; otherwise blocked with [[error:chat-restricted]] when disableIncomingChats is set, sender is on deny list (precedence), or allow list is non-empty and sender absent. Settings plumbing in src/user/settings.js: getSettings parses disableIncomingChats, chatAllowList, chatDenyList via new parseChatList helper (base h5, h10); saveSettings persists the new fields (base h7, h9, h11). Upgrades pattern per h4; the new idempotent migration seeding uid:{uid}:chat:allow from follows could not be created (apply_edits requires existing file) and remains unimplemented; UI templates not modified. Enforcement is server-side and returns exactly [[error:chat-restricted]].
